pitch_detail.notes: Bolted slab ending in a chute; 4 bolts, 30 m.
Right-facing corner with a roof and bolted slab; 5 bolts + gear, 40 m.
Roof systems and an arete on white marbled rock; 11 bolts, 30-40 m.
Corner ramp becoming an open book, with two variations; 3 bolts + gear, 30 m.
Corner past 4 bolts, traverse left, up quartzite dike, crux past a roof.
Airy dike climbing past a roof to a small ledge belay.
Crux: tenuous mantle and thin slab moves on quartzite.
Long varied slab, pockets, roofs, bulges, thin crux sections.
Overhanging blocky rock to anchor near top of Upper Town Wall; loose in places.
Use handline to reach corner, climb the corner.
Splitter finger crack, doubles in blue/yellow Metolius sizes.
More splitter, cruiser with a sting-in-the-tail finish, added bolt at end.
Crimpy start to crystal pocket and small overlap, then friction slab.
Splitter tips to first knuckle for 20ft, capped with steep bolted finish.
Slab traverse, right-facing corner, thin flake work, well bolted at crux.
Slab crux near start, balance moves on short slab near anchor.
Layback cracks into upper slab climbing with bolt protection.
